tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Advance Work (ANR-03) including seedlings raising, under DDF, 50 Ha, Kundaragi FSy No-55 in Bilagi Range during 2026-27

itemList.description: Survey and demarcation of Plantation boundary lines after clearing the rank growth to a width of 2 m. in the areas with sparse under growth.

Excavation of pits by mechanical means of size by 0.75m x 0.75m x 0.75m with vertically cut edges to make a uniform cube and heaping the excavated soil (1/3rd top soil on the upper side & 2/3rd on the lower side) in Ordinary soil (278 pit)

Barbed wire Fencing (3 Stands) with wooden posts
Purchase of TATA Special Hot dipped G.I. Barbed wire Medium coated with Zinc (30 Gms coated) 12 x 14 G
Purchase of fence posts including Transportation loading & unloading charges - private truck
Fixing the fence posts after digging pits of 30 cm x 30 cm x 40 cm depth and consolication, ensuring firm fixture
Unrolling and fixing barbed wire with 'U' nails in four rows, ensuring proper fixture. 3 Stand
Maintenance of 5"x8" seedlings for trasplanting into 10"x16" PBs
Cost of HDPE woven bags including 18% GST.

Procurement of 1.91 cum. Farm Yard Manure / Compost, 1.91 cum. of Sand and 3.82 cum of Redearth i.e. totally 7.64 cum. (Ingredient ratio FYM : Sand : Red earth = 1:1:2) (8.72 cum needed for 10" x16" minus 1.08 cum of transplanted 5"x8" bag).
Mixing the ingredients, filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth.
Transplanting of 5” x 8” size bagged seedlings into 10” x 16” size bags after removal of the seedlings along with the trimmed ball of earth.
Cost of collection of 8-10 ft. long stakes of 'Chewa' or split dowga bamboos from departmental forest / plantation for providing vertical support to each plant including delivery at nursery site.
Tying of plant to the vertical stake, and pruning of buds as it grows once in a fortnight.
Watering to the Polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01.08.2026 to 31.03.2027 (243 days).
Shifting and grading the polythene-bagged seedlings.
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/compounds, their application, nursery pumpset fuel/maintainence/ electricty bill of pumpset and other unforseen items and charges.

SMC Trenches
Excavation of contour trenches of Size 4m X 1m (width) X 0.50m (Depth) with25 cum Septa X 1 trenches = 2 m3
